title: Studio ComfyUI Workflow
description:
A ComfyUI workflow catalog package: Studio metadata + manifest + the native ComfyUI API graph in a single file. Metadata fields (slug, version, name, description, author, category) live at the top level; the manifest fields (service, models, capabilities, parameters, generation, node_mappings, outputs, requirements) declare everything the API, UI, and worker need to execute the package; the raw ComfyUI graph (numeric node IDs as keys) lives under the `graph` key, opaque to Studio and rendered by the worker after parameter injection. Manifest fields are optional at the schema level so pre-manifest packages keep validating; cross-field coherence (model references, node existence) is enforced by scripts/validate-comfyui-manifests.py.

Stability: future versions of this schema must remain backward-compatible with content authored against earlier versions of itself - once a package is published with a given version, it must continue to validate against the schema in force at install time. Add fields conservatively (optional first); promote to required only with a major schema revision and a migration story.

inputPath.description: Dotted literal path into a node spec (no expressions).

options.description: Enum choices: bare strings, or value/label pairs when the UI label differs.

pattern.description: Regex a string parameter's value must match; the worker validates against it.

suggestions.description: Combobox suggestions for a free-form string parameter (UI-only, not a closed set): bare strings, or value/label pairs when the UI label differs.

scope.description: "api" marks parameters the API consumes before enqueue; everything else reaches the worker.

when.description: Name of a boolean parameter gating this one's visibility.

slug.description: Stable identifier used as the catalog key. Must match the file basename.

name.description: Human-readable workflow name shown in the UI.

description.description: Short description of what the workflow does.

category.description: Primary category for grouping in the UI (e.g. image, video, audio).

service.description: Which service this package belongs to and how its jobs route.

id.description: Groups packages into one service; packages sharing an id form its model enum.

queue.description: Must name a pre-registered queue; unknown queues are rejected at install time.

models.description: Selectable model variants: literal node-input assignments applied when a model is selected, plus per-model parameter defaults.

default.description: Marks the default model for the service this package belongs to; at most one across all packages sharing service.id.

defaults.description: Parameter values overlaid on the package defaults when this model is selected.

required_models.description: Filenames this model needs on disk; each must resolve to a package-level required_models entry.

parameters.description: All user-facing parameters and their UI hints. The manifest owns these; provider adapter-config is a shell.

generation.description: Model quality band the worker enforces when deriving generation dimensions.

node_mappings.description: Parameter name (or worker-derived value like width/height) to the graph inputs it writes.

outputs.description: Where finished media leaves the graph.

required_models.description: Union of every distinct model file across all models[] entries; feeds the install-time notice and download tables.

directory.description: ComfyUI model kind, optionally with the subfolder the file sits in (vae/FLUX1). The kind is the first segment.

access.description: Independent of license. "gated": the source requires an account and browser terms acceptance; an unauthenticated fetch returns HTML, not weights. Omitted means open.

graph.description: Native ComfyUI API graph - keys are node IDs (string-encoded integers), values are node specs. Opaque to Studio. The worker injects user parameters into this graph before submitting to ComfyUI.
